_doc: Astute employee role registry — drives VQ buyer-resolution fallback and RFQ salesrep resolution. Maintained by operator (Jake Harris). The vq-loading-agent (and any downstream consumer needing the buyer/role distinction) checks an ad_user_id against this registry. If a candidate is in `buyers`, assign as chuboe_buyer_id. If in `support`, do NOT use as buyer — fall through to RFQ-owner (chuboe_rfq.chuboe_user_id) or escalate. Anyone in neither list → escalate to Jake for review. The `rfq_support` list is for support staff who forward RFQs on behalf of salesreps — they should NOT be assigned as salesrep; walk deeper in the chain instead.
_source: session with operator 2026-05-20; rfq_support added 2026-08-17 per external notifications plan.
